title: Plant Manager
text:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Join Hubell in our Aiken, SC facility. We are searching for a Plant Manager who will be responsible for the daily operations, efficiency, safety, and quality of the facility. This is an onsite position.

#LI-AO1

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

* Managing overall manufacturing activities of the Business Unit.
* Maintaining a safe working environment consistent with all local, state and OSHA requirements.
* Originating, measuring, and improving key indicators for the business unit (Safety, Quality, Delivery, Inventory and Cost).
* Ensuring the quality systems are established and maintained.
* Driving and assisting with materials management across facilities including interacting with supplier base.
* Continuing to enhance the LEAN culture. Ensuring the production area maintains a clean, well-organized environment through “continuous improvement” and 5S. Implementing and driving “continuous improvement” activities by eliminating non valued added activities in the manufacturing process (waste elimination).
* Developing budgets and forecasts. Approving expenditures for supplies, materials, and human resources, ensuring that materials, labor and equipment are used efficiently to meet productivity and customer requirements.
* Establishing work requirements and ensuring production schedules are met.
* Developing Staff and a culture within the business unit dedicated to the highest levels of quality and customer service.

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Management or a related field *(required)*
* Master’s in Business Administration preferred.
* 15+ years of experience in a manufacturing setting *(required)*
* 15+ years of experience as a Plant Manager or a similar role in a medium to heavy manufacturing environment.
* SAP experience.
* Experience working in a union environment.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing.
* Operational Excellence or Lean Certification.
